text:
Joan (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Arbor activation today. Goal: get prod-readiness by D+30, basic routing + secrets integrated by D+14, and handover to Support after week 6. Please confirm owners below and any immediate risks.

Ravi (Solutions): I can take integration owner for the webhook + auth flow. Will need access to their VPC details. @Marisol can you share contact for infra?

Marisol (Arbor): Hi all — thanks. I'll share infra contact, it's Priya in our cloud team (pri@arbor.co). We prefer a Tuesday or Thursday for the first 90m technical deep-dive.

Kai (SE): I'll handle the initial runbook and test prompts. Planning a short eval set (10 prompts) to baseline quality. Suggest we run the eval both on hosted and dedicated staging.

Joan (CSM): Owners so far: Integration = Ravi, Runbook + Eval = Kai, Customer Eng lead = Marisol, CSM = Joan. Ops/playbook = open — any volunteers?

Ravi (Solutions): I can help with ops/playbook too during setup, but handoff to on-call should be SRE. @OpsBot can you create a post-kickoff checklist and add an on-call rotation stub?

OpsBot: Created checklist #arbor-onboard-checklist and added initial items: secrets, network rules, model pinning, smoke tests. ETA for checklist filled: 48h.

Marisol (Arbor): For timelines — Arbor legal needs a short security review (2–3 business days). If that slips, our D+14 could shift. Flagging as potential renewal-risk impact if infra access delayed.

Joan (CSM): Noted. Success criteria (proposed): 1) End-to-end inference call from prod client to Redwood returns <500ms p95 on staging; 2) Eval quality delta <5% vs baseline; 3) Secrets stored in their KMS and access audited; 4) Customer sign-off on runbook. Agree?

Kai (SE): Agree on criteria. For the latency target, we'll capture p95 from their region — need region info from Marisol.

Marisol (Arbor): Primary region is eu-west-1. Also: preferred weekly check-ins on Fridays at 11am UTC for the first month.

Joan (CSM): Great — setting recurring Friday 11am UTC. Quick checklist snippet for the first two weeks:

```
D0: Kickoff + technical deep-dive
D1-D7: Infra access, secrets, network allowlist
D7-D14: Integration tests, smoke, runbook draft
D14-D30: Load tests, eval runs, handover prep
```

Ravi (Solutions): I'll post an integration playbook draft by EOD tomorrow.

Kai (SE): I'll seed the eval prompts and share the results dashboard link here when ready.

Marisol (Arbor): Thanks — I'll get Priya to accept calendar invite and push legal review.

Joan (CSM): Perfect. Action items: Joan — calendar + stakeholder list; Ravi — integration playbook; Kai — eval prompts; Marisol — infra contact + legal review. If anything slips, reply here. :thumbsup:

Marisol (Arbor): :thumbsup: looking forward to it.

Ravi (Solutions): +1

Kai (SE): +1
